ladder.label: NEARING A HIGH
ladder.why: A daily bottoming setup did fire (swing low in, momentum turned up), but it's LATE — price is already extended above the cycle low (formed ~3 day(s) ago @ 42.46) and momentum is fading — the 3-day/weekly momentum has crossed down. A momentum cross is a LAGGING confirmation: after a vertical run it only triggers once the move is mature, so the bottoming entry has already passed. This is a chase, not a fresh buy.
ladder.next: Don't initiate here. Wait for a pullback toward the 10-day average — or the next daily-cycle low to set up — for a lower-risk entry; hold if you're already long.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down; 3-day crossed down
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down; 3-day crossed down (investor cycle week 12 · daily cycle broke its start low 12d ago).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): nearing a high. Bigger picture (no clear trend): mixed.
points: Bigger picture is mixed (no clear trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds
⚠ Failed cycle — price broke below the low that began this cycle (12d ago)

entry.text: You missed the bottoming entry — the low already formed and price is now extended (momentum is fading — the 3-day/weekly momentum has crossed down). Don't chase; wait for a pullback to the 10-day average or the next cycle low. Hold if already long.
entry.text_zh: 已错过筑底入场——低点已经形成，目前价格已拉伸（动量正在衰竭——3 日/周线动量已向下交叉）。不要追高；等待回调至 10 日均线或下一个周期低点。若已持有则继续持有。

ladder.why_zh: 日线筑底形态确实已经触发（摆动低点出现、动量转向上行），但为时已晚——价格已显著高于周期低点（约 3 天前形成 @ 42.46）且动量正在衰竭——3 日/周线动量已向下交叉。动量交叉属于滞后确认：在垂直拉升之后，只有当走势已经成熟时才会触发，因此筑底入场早已错过。这是追高，而非新的买入。
ladder.next_zh: 此处不宜建仓。等待回调至 10 日均线附近——或下一个日线周期低点构筑成形——以获得风险更低的入场；若已持有则可继续持有。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.

reasons.en: just above the gamma flip — supportive but fragile (a dip flips dealers short)
reasons.zh: 刚高于 Gamma 翻转位 — 有支撑但脆弱（回调即转为空头 Gamma）

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -3.5 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -3.5 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

entry_signal.headline: Extended — wait for a pullback
entry_signal.headline_zh: 过度拉伸 — 等待回撤
entry_signal.action: You missed the bottoming entry — the low already formed and price is now extended (momentum is fading — the 3-day/weekly momentum has crossed down). Don't chase; wait for a pullback to the 10-day average or the next cycle low. Hold if already long.
entry_signal.action_zh: 已错过筑底入场——低点已经形成，目前价格已拉伸（动量正在衰竭——3 日/周线动量已向下交叉）。不要追高；等待回调至 10 日均线或下一个周期低点。若已持有则继续持有。

timing.next_trigger: You missed the bottoming entry — the low already formed and price is now extended (momentum is fading — the 3-day/weekly momentum has crossed down). Don't chase; wait for a pullback to the 10-day average or the next cycle low. Hold if already long.

headline.en: Rate risk runs through its market / growth beta, not a distinct duration leg.
headline.zh: 其利率风险通过市场／成长beta体现，并无独立的久期暴露。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta +0.15 ± 0.28 — low / noisy precision. Sector anchor (XLK) reads duration-neutral (-0.06). Negative inflation beta.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta +0.15 ± 0.28——精度低／噪声。 板块锚（XLK）为久期中性（-0.06）。 负通胀beta。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。

decision.headline: Extended — don't chase; wait for a pullback
decision.headline_zh: 过度拉升 — 勿追高；等待回撤
decision.gloss: Ran too far, too fast — don't chase; wait for a dip.
decision.gloss_zh: 涨得太快太远——勿追高；等待回撤。

trust.en: Event edge: insider buying (lone FDR survivor) + earnings-surprise PEAD context + revisions — a confluence read, not a standalone alpha
trust.zh: 事件驱动优势：内部人买入（唯一通过 FDR 的因子）＋盈利超预期 PEAD 背景＋评级调整 — 综合参考，非独立超额收益

regime.en: Mixed tape — balanced momentum / earnings edge
regime.zh: 混合行情 — 动量与盈利优势均衡

timing.text: You missed the bottoming entry — the low already formed and price is now extended (momentum is fading — the 3-day/weekly momentum has crossed down). Don't chase; wait for a pullback to the 10-day average or the next cycle low. Hold if already long.
timing.text_zh: 已错过筑底入场——低点已经形成，目前价格已拉伸（动量正在衰竭——3 日/周线动量已向下交叉）。不要追高；等待回调至 10 日均线或下一个周期低点。若已持有则继续持有。

axes.label: earnings · insider · revisions
axes.label_zh: 盈利 · 内部人 · 评级调整

falsifiers.en: Narrative basket (Non-AI Software) is below its long-term trend — validated drawdown gate: size down (the AI-buildout tape is rewarding leaders, not this one).
falsifiers.zh: 所属叙事篮子（非AI软件）已跌破长期趋势 — 已验证的回撤门槛：减小仓位。

trend.label: Trend
trend.gloss: Where price sits vs its 200-day average, and how strong the trend is (ADX).
trend.gloss_zh: 价格相对200日均线的位置，以及趋势强度（ADX）。

momentum.label: Momentum
momentum.gloss_zh: 日线／3日／周线三个周期的动量方向。

rel_strength.label: Relative strength
rel_strength.gloss_zh: 相对行业的价格强度——参考。

valuation.label: Valuation
valuation.gloss: Cheap/rich vs the market — context, not a buy signal.
valuation.gloss_zh: 相对大盘的估值——参考，非买入信号。

quality.label: Quality
quality.gloss: Business durability — will it survive the hold.
quality.gloss_zh: 业务的持久性——能否撑过持有期。

positioning.label: Positioning
positioning.value_zh: 内部人卖出 · 做空 8% 流通
positioning.gloss: Insider buying (an edge) and short interest (a risk).
positioning.gloss_zh: 内部人买入（优势）与做空比例（风险）。

volatility.label: Risk & size
volatility.value_zh: 常见回撤 -10% · 极端 -22% · → 建议仓位 0%
volatility.gloss: Expected downside drives how big to size.
volatility.gloss_zh: 预期下行决定建议仓位大小。

ownership.label: Ownership & flow
ownership.value_zh: 1 家 13F 持有人 · 减仓中（1→0 家，5季）
ownership.gloss: Who owns it and how concentrated; multi-quarter 13F holder trend (lagged ~45d) + how many backtest-skilled funds are buying (descriptive context).
ownership.gloss_zh: 谁在持有、集中度如何；多季度 13F 持有人趋势（滞后约45天）以及有多少回测优质基金在买入（仅供参考）。

macro.label: Macro exposure
macro.gloss: Rate / inflation sensitivity — context, never scored.
macro.gloss_zh: 利率／通胀敏感度——参考，不计分。

catalyst.label: Catalyst
catalyst.value_zh: 盈利超预期 -0.3 · 评级调整 +0.3
catalyst.gloss: Next earnings date and any earnings/revision edge.
catalyst.gloss_zh: 下次财报日期与盈利／评级优势。
